history.summary: A 2023 freehold 1BR in Upper East Coast (D16) at $890k / $1969 PSF, sitting below the $2175 URA median — but on only 2 transactions, so the median is meaningless. It's a niche shoebox in a small boutique block; the Bayshore TEL precinct is a real long-term catalyst, but 1BR exit liquidity is the weak link.
history.rating_rationale: The $890k quantum is accessible and the asking $1969 PSF looks ~9% under the quoted median — but that median rests on just 2 URA txns and is unreliable. Sea Pavilion is a small freehold development, and the 1BR is the most niche, narrowest-buyer-pool unit type. Arena record is poor (Elo 941, 100-214). The genuine upside is the maturing Bayshore precinct and TEL station 630m away. On balance: a freehold + catalyst story offset by shoebox illiquidity and a tiny development.
red_flags: Only 2 URA transactions — quoted median PSF is statistically meaningless
1BR shoebox = narrowest buyer/tenant pool and weakest resale liquidity
Small boutique development — shallow secondary market
catalysts: Bayshore precinct (new HDB + private housing) and Bayshore TEL station 630m away — multi-year area transformation
Freehold tenure in a 2023 (new) building near East Coast lifestyle
Greater East Coast / TEL connectivity uplift
